## How it was verified

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (for anything user-visible)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/templates.md`) if behaviour or architecture changed
- [ ] No brand values invented; no content model, limits or IndexedDB change without a version bump and migration
- [ ] No secrets, generated files or vendored files edited by hand
